label: KNOWN VIRTUAL RESOLUTION-POLICY CONTROLS; NO PHYSICAL ROBOT

protocol.geometry: Same original9x7 world/body/obstacle units/endpoint centers/contact convention as parents. Each matched comparison differs only in resolution policy; origin0.5, spacings1/0.5, A* FIFO. No state reuse across graphs.
protocol.statusRules: Coarse success stops. Only coarse UNREACHABLE triggers one fresh half-step search. Coarse BUDGET_EXCEEDED or INVALID_ENDPOINT_CLEARANCE stops. Fine result, including budget failure or graph exhaustion, is final. Retain stage raw results and sum all actual expansions.
protocol.budgets: 100 per stage, not100 total for the staged policy. Always-fine permits1 search/cap100, coarse-first at most2/cap200. These unequal maximum allowances are explicit; compare actual costs on known cases, not general success under equal total budgets.
protocol.aiExpectedKnownControls: Empty: direct fine13 versus staged coarse7, world length6. Doorway: direct fine28 versus staged12+28=40, world length7. Expected counts derive from archived stages; this is policy integration/accounting on known fixtures, not new independent samples or student numerical forecasts.
protocol.validation: Full regression suite for policy status/cost handling. Match every executed stage to archived core/world results, validate successful world segments and separate BFS, preserve failure stages and output immutability. Commit source/protocol/choice before configured execution.
protocol.attribution: Student selected offered option2 only, no rationale/count or implementation supplied. AI supplies policy details/budgets/code/tests/operation/analysis.
protocol.scope: Two known layouts/four paired-policy conditions. No population-weighted benefit, universal efficiency, continuous optimality, timing/energy/memory or physical robot claim. Historical raw data/core/browser unchanged.

parameters.units: original virtual cell-side lengths; not physical measurements

sampling.scope: Nested four-neighbor candidate lattice; original obstacle squares/world/body unchanged.

outcome.scope: Sample-graph shortest edge count when completed; geometric length=edge count*spacing, not global continuous optimum or runtime.

sweptPathValidation.scope: All axis-aligned world-center segments checked against original closed squares/boundary; no dynamics.

originalWorldPathAudit.scope: Exact axis-aligned segment/square and world-boundary distances for this assumed disk; no dynamics or global continuous optimality.

result.scope: Fixed original virtual geometry; retry once only on coarse UNREACHABLE. Sum all stage expansions. No state reuse, global continuous optimality or physical/runtime claim.
